data.one_liner: A WebView2-powered webview plugin for Flutter on Windows.
data.what_it_does: Renders Microsoft Edge WebView2 off-screen as a Flutter texture, allowing seamless integration into the widget tree with keyboard focus handling, JavaScript bridging, cookie management, and a typed event API.
use_when: You need to embed a web browser or web content inside a Flutter desktop application for Windows.
You require robust keyboard focus management between Flutter text fields and the embedded webview.
You need a two-way JavaScript bridge or headless web automation on Windows.
avoid_when: You are building for platforms other than Windows.
The user's environment lacks the WebView2 Runtime and cannot have it installed.
strengths: Seamless texture composition avoiding native airspace issues.
Robust two-way JavaScript bridge and rich broadcast event streams.
Built-in keyboard focus management and high-DPI awareness.
weaknesses: Requires the underlying Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime to be installed on the user's machine.
Requires manual native setup with Visual Studio C++ build tools for development.
data.setup_notes: Requires Visual Studio 2022 with the Desktop development with C++ workload on your development machine, and the WebView2 Runtime on users' machines.
